guard/30217.htm.text: Sentinel Berros: May the peace of the lake rest upon you. My name is Berry, one of the Sentinels who guard the forest and the Mother Tree Glade. links.text: Ask about the world outside the forest.
See the Lord and get the tax rate information.

guard/30217-1.htm.text: Sentinel Berros: There was a time when I traveled here and there on the continent and saw many races and what the Humans call "cities" -- massive forests of buildings made by Human hands. Q00102_SeaOfSporesFever/30285-01.html.text: Sentinel Gartrandell: I don't think anything's wrong with me ... But Alberius has ordered me to take this medicine, and I must follow my orders.

Q00102_SeaOfSporesFever/30221-01.html.text: Sentinel Rayen: Ah, is this the fever medication? If only this could also erase the horrendous memories of my experiences in the Sea of Spores.

Q00102_SeaOfSporesFever/30219-01.html.text: Sentinel Veltress: Is this the medicine to treat the fever? Please tell Cobendell thank you for me.

Q00102_SeaOfSporesFever/30217-01.html.text: Sentinel Berros: Ah, the medicine concocted by Cobendell. Thank you. Thank you.
